- authority/Character_Removal_20261018.json controls identity exclusion.
- continuity/DELIVERY_LEDGER.json and continuity/CURRENT.json route to the newest matching-branch evidence; state/Post_Chris_Restart.json remains the preserved E20 baseline.
- `canon/presentation/Season3_Scene_Decision_Doctrine_20261010.md` is the sole story construction procedure.

## Production integrations

Existing Drive production folders preserve the original verified source snapshot and exact E19/E20 pairs, plus the readback-verified exact delivered E21–26 manuscripts and original checkpoints. All seven encyclopedia sections are populated in place. GitHub is now connected: private `kazekamimp3/kaze808`, selected-repository App scope, 44 exact imported files and a successful remote source-integrity run. The verified import is commit `a8796b3bd4c5c2b94c893b55db9dcc79fca5b703`; checkpoint branch `checkpoint/s7ns-verified-import-20261018` preserves it. AI Voice Generator is excluded by author direction; no active narration provider is selected. Research and visual production retain source/approval gates.

Populated as derived source directories; full source owners remain mandatory. Historical current labels cannot override newer scoped author instructions.
